english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the degree or quality of being soft, especially for materials and objects.

examples.english: The softness of this sofa is just right, so it’s comfortable to sit on.
examples.traditional: 呢張梳化嘅柔軟度啱啱好，坐落去好舒服。
examples.jyutping: ne1 zoeng1 so1 faa2 ge3 jau4 jyun5 dou6 ngaam1 ngaam1 hou2 zo6 lok6 heoi3 hou2 syu1 fuk6

english.note: Use this specifically for the physical flexibility of a body or material rather than flexibility in plans.

examples.english: Doing yoga can improve the body's flexibility.
examples.traditional: 做瑜伽可以提升身體嘅柔軟度。
examples.jyutping: zou6 jyu4 gaa1 ho2 ji5 tai4 sing1 san1 tai2 ge3 jau4 jyun5 dou6
